expires_today.title: The Blade Runner Collection by Titan Comics
expires_today.description: Discover the next chapter of Blade Runner’s story
expires_today.long_description: Are you on the side of humanity or technology? Lose yourself in the renowned Blade Runner comic series in this bundle from Titan Comics! Follow the continued stories of Rick Deckard and Roy Batty alongside new original characters in thrilling graphic novels and comics like Blade Runner Black Lotus: Las Vegas #1 and Blade Runner 2019: Vol. 1: Los Angeles, and see a new side of this iconic dystopian universe. Uncover what’s new with the Tyrell Corporation, and help support Direct Relief with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Learn to Make Games in Unity 2026 Bundle
expires_today.description: Learn to make games with Unity
expires_today.long_description:
Take your first steps into game development with one of the world’s most popular game engines, Unity. Whether you’re completely new to coding and game creation or ready to build bigger and more advanced projects, this bundle gives you the tools to grow your skills through hands-on learning. Start with beginner-friendly courses like Create Your First 2D Game in Unity and Create Your First 3D Game in Unity, then continue into larger projects like Complete Action RPG, Farming RPG, Tower Defense, and Construct a First Person Shooter. Along the way, you’ll learn C# programming, game systems, debugging, optimization, multiplayer, VR, and more. Pay what you want for a complete Unity learning bundle that can help turn your passion for games into real development skills and help support Alzheimer's Research UK with your purchase.

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before July 30th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Complete Character Creation for Games
expires_today.description: Bring characters to life in Blender
expires_today.long_description:
Dying to design your own epic game but have no idea where to begin? Been poking around in Blender but haven’t figured out all the tips and tricks? This bundle of Blender software courses will have you creating awesome boss fights and unique characters like you’ve been doing it for years! Learn the basics of character creation with courses on 3D, anime, and even low-poly characters! Bring them to life with comprehensive guides on animation and rigging! Let your imagination run wild sculpting orcs, dragons, mechs, and more! Get hours of resources and advice about all the details of game creation for the low price of your choosing, and support Girls Who Code with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before July 23rd, 2027.

expires_today.title: AI Foundations and Applications by Manning
expires_today.description: The hottest AI summer reading list
expires_today.long_description: Looking for a leg up on apps and AI? We’ve partnered with Manning Publications to curate the perfect summer reading series for curious, tech-focused minds! Make summer ’26 the season of growth for your career, and help support Feeding America with your purchase.

expires_tomorrow.title: Pathfinder Second Edition Bundle of Frogs! By Paizo Inc.
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
If your tabletop game nights are croaking, you could use a frog-themed boost from this bundle of Pathfinder Second Edition TTRPG adventures and miniature printable sets from Paizo! This bundle includes the ribbiting–erm, riveting Dawn of the Frogs, a mystery set in the swampy mires of Bog Bottom, both in PDF form and as a physical boxed set (miniature printables included)! If frogs aren’t your speed, try out the Extinction Curse storyline, beginning with the circus-set murder mystery The Show Must Go On! Or take to the skies in a flying airship and search the wilderness for magical beasts in Howl of the Wild! There are whole worlds to explore in this giant Pathfinder bundle, so get a crew together, grab it while it’s hot at the price of your choosing, and support the Craft Emergency Relief Fund with your purchase!

Keys Expire. Please redeem before December 31st 2026.

expires_within_72h.description: Make your projects come to life

expires_within_72h.title: Narrative 12 for $10 Bundle
expires_within_72h.description: Be a part of the story
expires_within_72h.long_description:
Fighting boss battles and journeying through open worlds is fun and all, but sometimes all a great game needs is a great story worth immersing ourselves in for a few hours. Get 12 games for $10 in this bundle full of tales of all genres, from hard boiled detective yarns with a retro spin to atmospheric mysteries about missing families. Search for clues through your empty childhood house in Gone Home. Tend your homestead and try not to think about the increasingly disturbing letters you get in the mail in The Stillness of the Wind. Join an occult detective in the kinda-haunted city of Twin Lakes in The Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark. There are even more great stories to experience in this bundle, so grab these games now for just $10, and support mental health charity Take This with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before July 31st, 2027.
